action_summary: The verifier that every discovery path calls returned True for any format it had no check for, and for compound names it was handed the outer wrapper only. Measured on 073540d with an empty transfer store, discover() closed SIX of eight goal families over bytes nothing checked: png->jpg by ['run_unexpand'] (a whitespace tool), pkg.tar.gz by ['run_gzip'] (a gzip of one file), data.csv by ['run_tar'] (a tarball), commit-log.txt by ['run_md5sum.textutils']. Each was remembered as proven, so the falseness was durable. Now: container ownership is checked before any parser (a tar called out.csv is not a csv however happily csv.reader reads it), the LONGEST suffix the table knows is the one whose verifier must be satisfied (pathlib says .gz for pkg.tar.gz and that answer was the bug), a digest has a width, a table has a separator, and a format that cannot carry evidence (.txt/.md) or that needs two layers this channel resets between (.tar.gz) is REFUSED BY NAME at 0 ms instead of being closed or paid 95 s for. Census 7/8 closed with 6 false -> 3/8 closed with 0 false.
